summary: Frontend-only validation of the 5-screen UI redesign on RidePact (Rovo) mobile Expo web preview at 390x844. Seeded a multi-member group via public API (student@university.edu Alex Rivera as booker + taylor@university.edu Taylor Kim as rider, DTW airport, private ride + join, booked + $57 fare entered + ride completed) and then drove the UI as student B (Taylor) through the redesigned screens. VERIFIED: (1) Group Details RIDER view (/group?id=...) renders the summary card with 'UMich → DTW', 'Completed · 2/4' pill, capacity user-glyphs, all rows (Date/Suggested Departure/Book By/Vehicle/Total Bags/Est. fare), a RIDERS section WITHOUT any pickup addresses, both members listed (Alex Rivera with BOOKER pill + Taylor Kim), no 'ADDRESSES VISIBLE TO YOU ONLY' string (correctly gated), and the action stack shows Fare Split + Group Chat + 'Leave →' link — matches spec. (2) Group Chat (/group-chat?groupId=...) shows header 'UMich → DTW' with date 'September 9' below, pinned pastel 'Ride Details' card with pin icon, chevron toggle collapses/expands the details successfully, Depart/Book By/Vehicle/Est. fare rows render, 'View Fare Split' CTA present (because status=completed the deadline row is correctly hidden), system messages render ('Taylor Kim joined the group', 'Cab booked — check the fare split', 'Ride marked complete'), sending 'Hello from Taylor test' via chat-input + chat-send button posts the message and it renders in the list. (3) Fare Split RIDER view (/fare-split?groupId=...) renders the DARK navy 'Ride Complete' hero with RovoCar + RovoCloud, 'FARE SPLIT' section label, white card with Total Fare $57.00, per-member rows including 'Alex Rivera (Booker · 50%) $28.50' and bold 'You (50%) $28.50', 'Copy $28.50 Pay @alexr' pill (fare-copy) with 'Tap to copy amount and Venmo handle' helper, 'PAYMENT STATUS' list with AR + You rows both showing PENDING badge and AR carrying the BOOKER pill, 'I’ve Paid → Continue to Rating' button. Tapping fare-i-paid successfully calls faresApi.confirm and navigates to /rate?groupId=... (verified page.url). (4) Rate Riders (/rate) renders 'Rate Riders' header and shows one card for Alex Rivera (the OTHER member) with RELIABILITY + PUNCTUALITY 5-star rows (all tappable — clicked rate-rel-<uid>-4 and rate-pun-<uid>-5), 'Submit Ratings' button submits the pending ratings and router.replace('/(tabs)/home') fires, ending on Home. NO red screens, NO runtime PAGEERR events, and no console errors observed across the full happy path. Two ISSUES worth main-agent attention: (a) The Rate card for the booker DOES NOT render the 'BOOKER' pill — Rate.jsx reads m.isBooker/m.profileImage but the backend GET /api/ratings/pending response only returns {userId,name,initials,alreadyRated} (see /app/backend/src/routes/ratings.js lines 20-27). Since this is a UI-only redesign iteration, the fastest fix is server-side: include isBooker (String(user._id)===String(group.bookerId)) and profileImage on each pending entry. (b) Cosmetic: on the pinned Ride Details card the chevron direction is inverted vs common UX — when expanded the icon is ChevronDown (expected ChevronUp / '˄'); collapse+expand both work regardless. Non-scope but observed: Home 'YOUR UPCOMING RIDE' card renders 'Campus → [object Object]' — appears the home tile does not resolve group.airport.code (unrelated to this iteration's 5 screens).

minor.issue: Response omits isBooker and profileImage; Rate.jsx expects both to render the BOOKER pill and the avatar image on each rate card. Fix in /app/backend/src/routes/ratings.js — include booker flag + user.profileImage in the projected member payload.

ui_bugs.issue: BOOKER pill never renders on the booker's rate card because the response from /api/ratings/pending does not include m.isBooker (rate.jsx line 102 gates on it). Same reason profileImage fallback (line 94) always falls through to initials. Verified via DOM innerText: 'BOOKER' string absent on the Rate screen after successfully navigating with the booker as the only other member.

Chevron direction is inverted vs. the common expand/collapse pattern — ChevronDown is shown when the card is EXPANDED and ChevronUp when COLLAPSED (see /app/frontend/app/group-chat.jsx line 175). Functionality works; swap the two icons for correct affordance.

issues: YOUR UPCOMING RIDE card renders 'Campus → [object Object]' — not part of the 5 redesigned screens in this iteration but visible to any user after login; the destination field seems to receive an unformatted airport object. Flagging for main agent even though out-of-scope.

action_items: Include isBooker + profileImage on each entry returned by GET /api/ratings/pending (routes/ratings.js), OR compute isBooker client-side in rate.jsx by comparing userId to group.bookerId fetched via groupsApi.get(groupId). Preferred: server-side, single source of truth.
Swap Chevron icons in /app/frontend/app/group-chat.jsx line 175 so ChevronUp shows when expanded and ChevronDown when collapsed.
Out of iteration scope but noted: fix the Home 'YOUR UPCOMING RIDE' tile so the destination renders the airport code (or customDestinationName) instead of '[object Object]'.
critical_code_review_comments: fare-split.jsx correctly branches on group.isCurrentUserBooker; RIDER view fully lives in the top block (dark navy background) and BOOKER view in the bottom block. Both share load()/act() helpers — clean.
group-chat.jsx onPinnedCTA covers both un-booked (booker taps to POST /groups/:id/book → then push to /fare-split) and booked (direct push to /fare-split) — good.
rate.jsx assumes ratingsApi.pending returns m.isBooker and m.profileImage; the current backend does not — mismatch surfaced by this run.
group.jsx Row helper uses valueColor to color the 'Book By' when countdown is urgent — accessible.
No hardcoded URLs; EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is respected via api/rides + api/social clients.

All interactive elements on the 5 redesigned screens carry testID (chat-back, chat-header, chat-pinned, chat-book-now, chat-input, chat-send, chat-deadline, fare-back, fare-header, fare-input, fare-save/fare-complete, fare-track-i, fare-mark-i, fare-total, fare-copy, fare-i-paid, fare-status-i, fare-error, group-header, group-status, group-pickups, group-rider-i, group-copy-addresses, group-book-now, group-fare-split, group-chat, group-leave, group-pickup-shared, group-pickup-multi, group-save-cta, group-join, group-accept-booker, leave-cancel, leave-confirm, rate-header, rate-card-<uid>, rate-rel-<uid>-1..5, rate-pun-<uid>-1..5, rate-submit, rate-error). Excellent coverage.

seed_data_creation: Created 1 private group (id=6a9a7d0669639b6c3a73a4bc) with Alex Rivera as booker + Taylor Kim as rider, direction=university_to_airport, airport=DTW, travelDate=2026-09-09, booked, fare $57 entered, ride marked complete. Both students are pre-existing seeded accounts. Test data not cleaned up so main agent can re-open the same group state; running the seed script again spawns a fresh isolated group.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To reach Fare Split RIDER + Rate Riders you need TWO logged-in students in one group with the booker having entered the fare + marked the ride complete. Use /app/backend/tests/seed_multi_member_group.py — it logs in both seeded students, creates a private ride as A (mode=private auto-creates a group with A as booker), has B create a matching public ride, joins A's group via POST /api/groups/:id/join, A books via /api/groups/:id/book, A enters fare via POST /api/fares/:groupId (NOT /groups/:id/fare — that returns 404), then completes via /api/groups/:id/complete. Screen paths (mobile web): /group?id=<gid>, /group-chat?groupId=<gid>, /fare-split?groupId=<gid>, /rate?groupId=<gid>. Welcome screen requires clicking data-testid='welcome-signin' to reach data-testid='signin-email'. Full-screen viewport 390x844.
rca_of_issue: Rate card missing BOOKER pill — root cause: /app/backend/src/routes/ratings.js line 20-27 projects only {userId,name,initials,alreadyRated}. rate.jsx line 102 reads m.isBooker to render the pill; because that field is absent, the ternary short-circuits and no pill is drawn. Reproduction: log in as any rated user, navigate to /rate?groupId=<completed-group-with-other-booker>, inspect DOM — no element with 'BOOKER' text exists on the rate card. Mitigation (server): populate GroupMember → group.bookerId once, project String(m.user._id)===String(group.bookerId) as isBooker plus optional profileImage from User. Mitigation (client-only, if backend must stay untouched): in rate.jsx fetch groupsApi.get(groupId) once and mark isBooker by comparing userId to group.bookerId inside the members map.
